ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 80-85% of the visible surface area, contrasted by low-intensity (black) pixels along the periphery and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a contiguous high-intensity white blob across both lobes. A thick, continuous low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge and encompasses the entirety of both fluke tips. Vertical low-intensity linear streaks are localized at the distal end of the left lobe. Small, isolated low-intensity spots are scattered across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees; the depth of the notch extends significantly into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular serrations visible along both lobes. A prominent, high-amplitude semi-circular indentation is located on the inner-third of the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward-sweeping curve from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in tapered, slightly hooked trailing points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several circular, low-relief bumps and shallow depressions on the ventral surface of the left lobe and central region, consistent with historical barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular excision/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; multiple raised circular scars on the left-central lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique vertical 'dripping' black pigment pattern localized on the far left ventral tip.
